summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The John Hancock Large Cap Opportunities ETF (JLCO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in large cap equity. The fund is actively managed, seeking long-term capital appreciation through exposure to large-cap US equity securities. Security selection is based on a fundamental, bottom-up research process. JLCO was launched on Jul 15, 2026 and is issued by John Hancock.

holdings.infoBox: JLCO is an equity ETF with a total of 56 individual holdings. The top holdings are Microsoft stock at 8.11%, Alphabet at 6.92%, Amazon.com at 6.32%, NVIDIA at 5.90%, and JPMorgan Chase & Co. at 4.01%.
